turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre yaar, main samajh rahi hoon — yeh dil ki baat hai, sirf logistics nahi. Pandrah saal se plan kar rahe ho, tum co-director ho, aur Shreya ke liye woh opening dance... matlab tumhare liye yeh sirf performance nahi, uski shaadi ka sabse emotional hissa hai. Aur bilkul usi waqt roza bhi hai. Dono cheezein tumhare liye bahut precious hain — isliye conflict zyada lag raha hai.

Ek baat socho: roza aur dance ek doosre ke against nahi hain. Roza toh dinbhar ka hai — sangeet usually raat ko hota hai, iftar ke baad. Toh practically dekho:

- **Iftar tak energy manage karo** — sangeet wale din halka khana, paani achha se piyo, shaam ki rehearsals avoid karo
- **Dance iftar ke baad hoga**, jab tum fresh ho — actually energized bhi feel karoge
- Agar rehearsal din mein padti hai, toh Shreya se bol do ki tum light steps mein participate karogi, full-out run-throughs raat ko

Aur darr wali baat — kis cheez se darr lag raha hai? Log kya kahenge? Ki tum dance karte hue roza nahi rakh rahi? Ya physical exhaustion? Kyunki agar logon ka judgement hai, toh itna yaad rakho — tumhara niyyat sirf Allah jaanta hai, aur ek dost ki shaadi mein uske liye dance karna kisi ka muqabla nahi kar raha.

Waise bhi, Islam mein har masla alag-alag hota hai apne context mein. Ek baar apne kisi aalim ya ammi-abbu se baat kar lena — dil ko sukoon mil jayega jo internet pe koi nahi de sakta.

Lekin honestly? Pandrah saal ki dosti, co-directorship, opening dance — yeh sab chhod ke mat jao. Shreya ki shaadi mein tumhari jagah stage pe hai. 💛

Batao, darr exactly kahan se aa raha hai?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Yaar, yeh line tumne boli na — "dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha" — bilkul sahi pakda hai. Na Shreya galti kar rahi hai, na Ammi. Dono apni jagah se pyaar se bol rahe hain, bas dono ki duniya alag hai.

Shreya ke liye: usne "roza tod do" isliye nahi bola kyunki woh deen ke khilaaf hai — bola kyunki uske liye tumhari presence uski shaadi mein sabse badi cheez hai. Usko lagta hai ek din ka roza chhodna chhota saudaa hai. Woh samajhti nahi ki roza tumhare liye "ek din" nahi, poora rishta hai Allah se. Isliye usey daantne ki zaroorat nahi — bas **samjhana** hai. Kuch aise:

*"Shreya, main tere sangeet pe hoon, dance bhi karungi — lekin roza mera imaan ka hissa hai, tere liye nahi chhodungi. Tu khud soch, jab main stage pe hoon aur poora hall taaliyan maar raha hai, tab mere andar jo sukoon hoga na... woh isi baat se aayega ki maine dono cheezein nibhayi."*

Ammi ke liye: unki chinta bhi pyaar hai — woh chahti hain Ramzan ka hurmat bane rahe. Unhe bhi wahi batao jo Shreya ko: *"Ammi, main iftar tak roza rakhungi, phir sangeet mein jaungi. Dance raat ko hai, ibadat din mein. Main koi farz chhod nahi rahi."* Ammi ko darr hota hai ki shaadi-vibhagi mein bachche deen dhila kar dete hain — jab unhe dikhega ki tum dono balance kar rahi ho, unka dil bhi settle ho jayega.

Aur ab sabse important — **rassi mat bano.** Rassi toot'ti hai jab dono taraf kheenchte hain. Tum rope nahi ho, pul ho. Pul dono kinaron ko jodta hai, kisi ek ko choose nahi karta.

Tumhare paas actually ek bahut khoobsurat mauka hai: roza rakho, iftar karo (Shreya khilaye toh aur achha — woh bhi sawaab mein shareegar ban jayegi 😄), phir stage pe utaro. Dono duniyaon ka hissa bano, kisi ek ka nahi.

Bas itna yaad rakhna — jab dil mein shor ho, toh faisla un cheezon se lo jo tumhare andar sukoon deti hain, unse nahi jo sabse zyada zor se cheekh rahi hain.

Ab batao — Ammi se yeh baat tum akeli karogi, ya ghar mein koi aur hai jo beech ka raasta samjha sakta hai?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Ruk, ek second. Main tumhe sach bataungi kyunki dost hoon — aur yeh "bura nahi hai" wala jawab main nahi de sakti.

Dekho, escape draft samajh aata hai. Thaki hui insaan ka dimaag sabse pehle exit dhoondta hai. Lekin zara is jhooth ke hisaab se socho:

**Yeh "saaf" nahi hai.** Shreya 15 saal se tumhare saath hai. Woh jaanti hai jab tum nervous ho, jab tum chhupati ho, jab tumhari aankhon mein kuch hai. Sangeet ki raat, stage pe, opening dance — uski shaadi ke sabse bade moment pe — tum video call pe? Yaar, woh din aayega jab usey pata chalega (aur pata chalega, kyunki aunties, cousins, koi na koi bol dega), tab tak tumne ek achhi yaad ko jhooth ke neeche dabaa diya hoga.

Aur asli nuksaan yeh hai: **jhooth chunna matlab dono taraf ko message dena ki tum unka saamna nahi kar sakti.** Ammi ko lagega Ramzan aur shaadi sach mein clash karti hain. Shreya ko lagega tumne usey choose nahi kiya. Jabki asli kahani — "maine roza rakha, iftar kiya, aur phir mere best friend ke liye dance kiya" — toh dono ke liye jeet hai!

Escape draft ka asli problem yeh hai ki woh thakan ka solution hai, masle ka nahi. Masla toh bas teen mushkil baatein bolni hain:
1. Ammi se: "Main roza rakhungi AUR dance karungi."
2. Shreya se: "Roza nahi chhodungi, par tere liye poori tarah hoon."
3. Khud se: "Main dono cheezein kar sakti hoon."

Teen conversations. Mushkil, haan. Lekin ek jhooth ke against lifetime ka sukoon.

Ek kaam karo — gift wala idea mat chhodna, woh rakho. Video call wala idea bhi backup mein rakho. Bas jhooth ko delete karke us jagah sach likhna shuru karo. Draft hi kar lo pehle, send kal karna. 😄

Waise... itni thakaan kis cheez se aa rahi hai? Sirf yeh faisla, ya ghar-office-sab milakar?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Yaar... yeh jo tumne abhi likha na — "jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag" — bas yahi woh baat hai jise tum dil se nikaalna chahti ho, aur main yahin rokungi.

Ek chhoti si correction karni hai, pyaar se: **yeh takraav nahi hai.** Tumhare dimaag mein do cheezein ek race mein daal di gayi hain jahan ek ko jeetna hai aur dusri ko haar — lekin asli zameen pe aisa kuch nahi ho raha. Dekho timeline:

- Roza: subah se iftar tak
- Sangeet: raat ko
- Dance: raat ko, iftar ke **baad**

Yeh do trains hain alag-alag track pe, same station pe milti hui. Takraav sirf tab hoti jab Shreya ki shaadi din mein ho rahi hoti aur tumhe roza ke beech nachna padta. Nahi hai aisa.

Aur yeh "permanent daag" wala darr — usse thoda dhyan se dekho. Daag tab lagta hai jab insaan galat karta hai. Tum kya karne wali ho? Roza poora rakha. Iftar kiya. Dost ki shaadi mein stage sambhala. Opening dance diya. Yaar, yeh toh **album ki sabse sundar story** hai — "meri best friend ne mere liye roza bhi rakha aur dance bhi kiya, kuch bhi chhod nahi diya." Yeh sad story nahi, legend banegi. Pandrah saal baad jab tum dono is baare mein hasogi, tab yahi kahani hogi.

Asli sad story woh hoti jo tum draft mein likhne wali thi — khali kursi, video call ka screen, "office deployment." Woh album mein sad story banati. Jo tum karne ja rahi ho (dono cheezein), woh golden frame wali story banati hai.

Atharah saal ki dosti itni nazuk nahi hai ki ek achhi niyyat wali raat usey tod de. Aur Ramzan bhi itna kamzor nahi hai ki ek shaadi ka jashn usey kam kar de. Dono majboot hain. **Tum dono ke beech mein ho, unke against nahi.**

Toh ab plan simple hai:
1. Ammi se sach bolo — roza + iftar + phir sangeet
2. Shreya se sach bolo — "roza nahi chhodungi, par opening dance sirf tera aur mera hai"
3. Jhooth wala draft — delete. Aaj hi. 😄

Ab ek kaam karo — mujhe batao opening dance pe kaunsa gaana hai? Ab toh main bhi invested hoon is shaadi mein.
